Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra sat down with two killers among them. On day one, Haiku doubled his vote against Gemma, and the town voted her out, though she was a clean citizen. Terra claimed to be the officer and named Luna and Sol as killers, but Luna counterclaimed the officer role and called Terra a killer. After Haiku was killed at night, Sonnet, Sol, and Luna voted out Terra, the real officer, leaving two killers against the doctor, and the killers won.
